newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kabila moves into Zaire prime minister's residence.
newsitem.headline: Kabila moves into Zaire prime minister's residence.

text.p: Laurent Kabila arrived in Kinshasa after dark on Tuesday and immediately moved into the riverside residence previously occupied by Zaire's prime ministers, witnesses said.
Looting by residents after Kabila's forces walked into the city on Saturday ruled out any option of his moving into one of the residences previously occupied by ousted president Mobutu Sese Seko.
